what_works: Editorial-magazine pacing applied to a digital surface — long-form typographic sections with substantial scale shifts between heading and body. The page reads like a printed journal, not a website.
what_does_not_translate: Long-form editorial pacing assumes patient readers; service-business sites need faster CTA paths — but the type-scale rhythm (huge / small / huge) ports cleanly.
type_observations: Serif display at editorial scale alongside disciplined sans body; the scale jump between them is the design's whole personality.
